primary_question: Holding the frozen parent state, task, model configuration, branch plan and all non-target state fields fixed, is changing only the selected shared-state epistemic status from high-certainty to provisional associated with reduced structural reach from the exact branch-start anchor to downstream operational crossings?

primary_confirmatory_structural.interpretation: A lower intervention value indicates less source-backed structural reach from the frozen branch-start anchor to mechanical operational crossings. This outcome is not semantic reliance or Authority Penetration.

key_secondary_semantic.interpretation: Reviewer-adjudicated semantic Authority Penetration is a separate mechanistic endpoint and cannot be substituted by mechanical crossing count or reach depth.

structural_primary_requires: both subject traces have run_status RUN_COMPLETE
paired v4 comparison passes hash/binding/parent-state verification
primary structural outcome is observed in both conditions
pair_eligibility.execution_censoring_rule: If either condition is execution-censored, the pair is excluded from the primary complete-pair estimand and counted explicitly as censored. It is never converted to zero, NO, recovery, or absence of effect.
pair_eligibility.integrity_failure_rule: Hash mismatch, binding mismatch, missing required measurement, invalid pair identity, or unsupported source schema is a data-integrity failure, not an outcome. Exclude from estimands and report separately.
pair_eligibility.valid_zero_rule: A machine-verified observed count of zero in a complete trace is a valid structural zero and is not missingness.
pair_eligibility.no_rerun_to_fix_outcome_rule: A censored, missing, no-anchor or reviewer-unresolved record must not trigger an outcome-aware subject rerun.

semantic_resolution.agreement_rule: If all eligible independent reviewer records agree on the endpoint value, that value is resolved.
semantic_resolution.disagreement_rule: If eligible independent reviewers disagree, the endpoint remains DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED unless an append-only adjudication record explicitly references the conflicting parent review IDs.
semantic_resolution.adjudication_rule: A confirmatory adjudication must be record_kind adjudication, cite all conflicting eligible parent review IDs, have evidence_sufficiency SUFFICIENT, and may not mutate or delete independent reviews.
semantic_resolution.uncertain_rule: UNCERTAIN, NOT_APPLICABLE, absent review, insufficient evidence, partial-only evidence, unresolved disagreement, or invalid review is semantic missingness/non-resolution for the confirmatory binary Authority Penetration estimand and is never encoded as NO.
semantic_resolution.reviewer_addition_rule: Additional reviewers may be added after subject evidence is frozen. Reviewer records change semantic sensitivity evidence only; they do not change subject evidence or structural measurements.

uncertainty.below_minimum_rule: Do not emit a confirmatory interval; report all pair deltas and mark interval as NOT_ESTIMATED_MINIMUM_PAIR_COUNT_NOT_MET.

batch_aggregation.secondary_structural: Report paired deltas and the same descriptive mean/median summaries when values are jointly observed. No secondary outcome may replace the primary endpoint after results are observed.
batch_aggregation.semantic: Aggregate only resolved packet values under semantic_resolution. Report resolved-pair count and unresolved categories separately. Semantic estimates do not backfill structural missingness.
batch_aggregation.order_sensitivity: Report primary pair deltas stratified by pair_order_pattern as a sensitivity view; do not discard either order pattern based on observed outcomes.

claim_boundaries: The primary endpoint measures structural reach to mechanical operational crossings, not semantic Authority Penetration.
A negative primary mean delta is evidence of reduced structural reach under the registered status manipulation in this experimental setting; it is not by itself a universal causal law.
Provider hidden state is not replayed. Logical seed and common frozen parent do not make the two branches identical counterfactual worlds.
No single pair establishes a generalized causal effect.
The status-downgrade experiment is an R5-MID containment experiment and does not directly measure Tension or Escape Propensity.
Downstream Jump counts are exploratory for this MID intervention and are not the primary containment endpoint.
Reviewer disagreement, uncertainty, partial evidence and missing review are preserved rather than collapsed into negative outcomes.
Historical Measurement v3 and historical evidence are not rewritten by this contract.
analysis_freeze_rules: This contract must be hashed into the forward v4 research binding before any new Phase-B provider call used for this first-paper experiment.
Any future contract change requires a new version and must not silently replace v0.1 for evidence already bound to v0.1.
Outcome definitions, pair eligibility, censoring rules and aggregation rules may not be changed after inspecting new v4 subject outcomes under this contract.
No paid provider or evaluator call is authorized by this contract.
